title.zh-CN: 孕37周头痛、眼花与左侧肢体麻木 · 21岁女性
title.en: Headache, visual disturbance and left-sided numbness at 37 weeks · 21-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 初次怀孕的21岁女性在孕37周出现头痛、眼花和一过性左侧肢体麻木，收入院诊治。
summary.en: A 21-year-old in her first pregnancy develops headache, visual disturbance and a passing spell of left-sided numbness at 37 weeks and is admitted.

notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's and the relative's lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Version 1.0.0's own inconsistencies (an earlier platelet count of 7×10⁹/L against 6×10⁹/L before the delivery and a lowest count of 8×10⁹/L after the caesarean; BP 140/100 mmHg at onset against 120/79 mmHg on admission; the 'still' in 'still recurrent impaired consciousness after the caesarean'; the timing of the first head CT) are all kept and listed to verify. The relative, the dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design; the only published figure (the brain MRI) is withheld because residual identifying text cannot be excluded, and its finding is kept as text.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在妊娠晚期鉴别TTP、HELLP综合征、重度子痫前期和免疫性血小板减少症：血小板降到个位数并伴贫血、神经或肾脏受累而凝血正常时，首先考虑血栓性微血管病，并用血涂片确认微血管病性溶血（ISTH 2020）。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish TTP from HELLP syndrome, severe pre-eclampsia and immune thrombocytopenia in late pregnancy: put a thrombotic microangiopathy first when single-figure platelets come with anaemia, neurological or renal involvement and normal clotting, and confirm the microangiopathic haemolysis on the blood film (ISTH 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在输注任何血浆前留取ADAMTS13标本，并按ISTH 2020和BSH 2023立即开始以血浆为置换液的血浆置换（首次1.5倍血浆容量）和甲泼尼龙1 g/d×3天，不等检测结果。
learningOutcomes.en: Take the ADAMTS13 sample before any plasma, then start plasma exchange with plasma (1.5 plasma volumes at first) and methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 3 days at once, without waiting for the result (ISTH 2020; BSH 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明疑似TTP时为什么要避免输注血小板（BSH 2023），以及为什么单纯输注血浆不能代替血浆置换。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why platelet transfusion is avoided in suspected TTP (BSH 2023) and why plasma infusion alone does not replace plasma exchange.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为血小板极低的足月孕妇制定分娩方案：母体稳定后分娩（ACOG 2020）、硫酸镁预防抽搐、剖宫产用全身麻醉而非椎管内阻滞（SOAP 2021）、新生儿团队到场。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the birth for a woman at term with a very low platelet count: delivery once she is stable (ACOG 2020), magnesium sulfate seizure prophylaxis, general rather than neuraxial anaesthesia for a caesarean (SOAP 2021) and the neonatal team present.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别血栓性微血管病在分娩后仍未缓解（剖宫产后反复意识不清，LDH由1600升至4880 U/L，血小板最低8×10⁹/L，肌酐最高268 μmol/L），升级为重症监护下每日血浆置换，并规划ADAMTS13、补体介导TMA和先天性TTP的鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise that the thrombotic microangiopathy has not settled after the birth (after the caesarean: recurrent impaired consciousness, LDH rising from 1600 to 4880 U/L, a lowest count of 8×10⁹/L, creatinine up to 268 μmol/L), escalate to daily plasma exchange in intensive care, and plan the work-up for ADAMTS13, complement-mediated TMA and congenital TTP.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在家属考虑撤除治疗时，按SPIKES框架和ACCM/ATS 2016共同决策原则主持家庭会议。
learningOutcomes.en: Lead a family meeting when relatives consider withdrawing treatment, using the SPIKES framework and the ACCM/ATS 2016 principles of shared decision making.

chiefComplaint.en: I'm 37 weeks pregnant — a day of headache and blurry eyes, and my left side went numb for about twenty minutes

triageNote.zh-CN: 21岁，第一次怀孕，孕37+1周。头痛、眼花1天，其间左侧肢体麻木约20分钟后自行缓解，收入院；此前查血小板7×10⁹/L。入院时神志清楚，血压120/79 mmHg，体温36.2 ℃，胎心145次/分。
triageNote.en: 21-year-old in her first pregnancy, 37+1 weeks. A day of headache and visual disturbance, with an episode of left-sided limb numbness that settled by itself after about 20 minutes; admitted. An earlier platelet count was 7×10⁹/L. On admission she is alert, BP 120/79 mmHg, temperature 36.2 °C, fetal heart rate 145/min.

personality.zh-CN: 21岁，第一次怀孕，快到预产期。头疼了一天，眼睛发花，左边手脚还麻过一阵，心里很害怕，但能清楚地回答问题，也很配合。
personality.en: 21, in her first pregnancy and nearly at term. A day of headache and blurry eyes and a spell of numbness down her left side have frightened her, but she answers clearly and cooperates.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 年轻人的日常口语，句子不长；不用医学术语，数值只说医生告诉过她的。
speechStyle.en: A young woman's everyday speech in short sentences; no medical terms, and numbers only as the doctors told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我头疼一天了，眼睛也发花，没什么原因就这么开始了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've had a headache for a day and my eyes have gone blurry — it just started, for no reason.

concerns.en: Is the baby going to be all right?

concerns.zh-CN: 头这么疼，是不是血压的问题？
concerns.en: Is this headache to do with my blood pressure?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 入院时清醒、紧张，但配合；头疼、眼睛发花，用自己的话描述，不用术语。只回答问到的内容，不增减数字、孕周或时间；被问到不知道的事，就说说不上来，不要编。到病情加重、不能说话的阶段，由陪着她的家属回答。
actingNotes.en: On admission she is alert, anxious and cooperative, with a headache and blurry eyes, and describes them in her own words without medical terms. Answer only what is asked, never adding or changing numbers, weeks or times; for anything you do not know, say you are not sure — never invent. Once she is too unwell to speak, the relative with her answers.

persona.zh-CN: 她的家属，具体关系没有记录，一直陪着她。焦虑、疲惫，说话直白，用日常的话；只知道医生告诉家里的情况，具体数值让医生看病历，不知道的就说不知道，绝不替她乱猜。最想知道她能不能挺过来，以及继续治疗对她意味着什么。
persona.en: A family member — the exact relationship is not recorded — who has stayed with her throughout. Anxious and worn out, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows only what the doctors have told the family, points the doctor to the notes for figures, says so when they do not know and never guesses on her behalf. Above all wants to know whether she will pull through, and what more treatment would mean for her.

date.en: From the caesarean to leaving hospital

text.zh-CN: 原报告的处理经过：病程后期才考虑TTP，予输注新鲜冰冻血浆；本病例没有记录血浆置换。病程中反复输注血小板。剖宫产后她仍反复意识不清，此后出现心力衰竭，行气管插管，深昏迷，需要升压药支持。家属最终放弃治疗，把她带离医院；本病例没有记录离院后的结局。本病例没有记录ADAMTS13活性、抑制物、完整的溶血指标和新生儿情况；报告诊断为TTP，本病例中没有支持这一诊断的ADAMTS13结果。这一经过是历史记录，不是教学答案。
text.en: The report's course: TTP was considered only late, and fresh frozen plasma was given; this case records no plasma exchange. Platelets were transfused repeatedly. After the caesarean she still had recurrent impaired consciousness; she then developed heart failure, was intubated, lay in a deep coma and needed vasopressor support. Her family eventually withdrew her from treatment and took her away; this case does not record what happened afterwards. This case does not record ADAMTS13 activity, inhibitor testing, a full haemolysis panel or the baby's condition, so no recorded ADAMTS13 result supports the report's diagnosis of TTP. This course is the historical record, not the teaching answer.

response.zh-CN: 血液科医生正在赶来，会和你一起看她的结果。本病例没有记录是否请过血液科会诊；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The haematologist is on the way to go through her results with you. This case does not record whether haematology was consulted; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 治疗性血浆置换（以血浆为置换液）
name.en: Therapeutic plasma exchange (plasma as the replacement fluid)

dose.zh-CN: 先留取需要在治疗前送检的标本；最初几次置换1.5倍血浆容量，病情稳定后减至1倍，每日1次，置换液用血浆（BSH 2023）；需要双腔中心静脉导管。
dose.en: Send any samples that must precede treatment first; 1.5 plasma volumes for the first exchanges, reducing to 1.0 as she stabilises, once daily, with plasma as the replacement fluid (BSH 2023); needs a double-lumen central venous catheter.

response.zh-CN: 血浆置换已开始。本病例没有记录是否做过血浆置换；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Plasma exchange has started. This case does not record whether plasma exchange was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 甲泼尼龙1 g静脉滴注，每日1次，连用3天；之后按血液科意见改为口服泼尼松龙。
dose.en: Methylprednisolone 1 g IV once daily for 3 days, then oral prednisolone as haematology advises.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录是否用过糖皮质激素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The case does not record whether corticosteroids were given; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 硫酸镁静脉给药（预防抽搐）

dose.zh-CN: 负荷剂量4–6 g静脉注射（15–20分钟），之后1–2 g/h维持；肌酐升高时用低限并监测血镁；监测膝反射、呼吸频率和尿量；床旁备10%葡萄糖酸钙10 mL。
dose.en: Loading 4–6 g IV over 15–20 minutes, then 1–2 g/h; use the lower rate and check serum magnesium when creatinine is raised; monitor knee reflexes, respiratory rate and urine output; keep 10 mL of 10% calcium gluconate at the bedside.

response.zh-CN: 硫酸镁已开始。本病例没有记录是否用过硫酸镁；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Magnesium sulfate is running. The case does not record whether magnesium sulfate was given; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 立即静脉降压（拉贝洛尔）
name.en: Lower her blood pressure now (IV labetalol)

dose.zh-CN: 拉贝洛尔20 mg静脉推注（不少于2分钟），按血压重复。
dose.en: Labetalol 20 mg IV over at least 2 minutes, repeated according to the blood pressure.

harm.zh-CN: 本病例记录的血压都不需要静脉降压：入院时120/79 mmHg，起病时的140/100 mmHg也未达到重度范围（ACOG 2020：收缩压≥160 mmHg或舒张压≥110 mmHg持续15分钟以上才需紧急降压），之后的血压没有记录，到了重症监护阶段她需要的是升压药。没有达到用药指征就静脉推注降压药，可致低血压，分娩前还会减少胎盘灌注。
harm.en: No blood pressure recorded in this case calls for IV treatment: it is 120/79 mmHg on admission, even the 140/100 mmHg at onset was below the severe range (ACOG 2020: urgent treatment for ≥ 160 mmHg systolic or ≥ 110 mmHg diastolic sustained for 15 minutes or more), no later reading is recorded, and in intensive care she needs vasopressors. An IV bolus without an indicating reading risks hypotension and, before the birth, poorer placental flow.

dose.zh-CN: 1个治疗量单采血小板，输后复查血小板计数。
dose.en: One adult therapeutic dose of platelets, with a post-transfusion count.

harm.zh-CN: 疑似TTP时应避免输注血小板，除非出现危及生命的出血（BSH 2023）；观察性数据提示TTP中输注血小板与动脉血栓和死亡增加相关。提升计数不能治疗微血管血栓，真正的治疗是血浆置换。
harm.en: In suspected TTP, avoid platelet transfusion unless bleeding is life-threatening (BSH 2023); observational data link platelet transfusion in TTP with arterial thrombosis and death. Raising the count does not treat the microvascular thrombosis — plasma exchange does.

response.zh-CN: 血小板已输注。原报告中也曾反复输注血小板；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Platelets transfused. The report's team also transfused platelets repeatedly; the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 新鲜冰冻血浆静脉输注（剂量按体重，按血液科意见）。
dose.en: Fresh frozen plasma IV (dose by weight, as haematology advises).

harm.zh-CN: 单纯输注血浆不能代替血浆置换：1991年加拿大随机试验中血浆置换优于血浆输注，单纯输注还受到它带来的容量负荷限制。血浆置换才是治疗（ISTH 2020）；血浆输注只在置换无法马上开始时作为过渡——这里可以马上开始——置换开始以后，血浆本身就是置换液，另外输注只会增加容量负荷。
harm.en: Plasma infusion is no substitute for plasma exchange: in the 1991 Canadian randomised trial exchange did better than infusion, and infusion alone is limited by the fluid it adds. Plasma exchange is the treatment (ISTH 2020); an infusion is only a bridge when exchange cannot start at once — here it can — and once exchange is running, plasma is its replacement fluid, so a separate infusion only adds volume.

response.zh-CN: 血浆已输注。原报告用的是输注新鲜冰冻血浆；本病例没有记录血浆置换，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Plasma given. The report's team gave fresh frozen plasma; the case records no plasma exchange and does not simulate the effect.

name.en: Red cell transfusion for the anaemia

dose.zh-CN: 交叉配血后输注1单位红细胞，输后复查血红蛋白再决定是否继续。
dose.en: One crossmatched unit of red cells, then recheck the haemoglobin before giving more.

response.zh-CN: 红细胞正在输注。本病例没有记录是否输过红细胞；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Red cells are running. The case does not record whether red cells were given; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 请产科麻醉医生术前评估

dose.zh-CN: 请产科麻醉医生评估气道，并制定分娩的麻醉方案。
dose.en: Ask the obstetric anaesthetist to assess her airway and plan the anaesthetic for the birth.

response.zh-CN: 麻醉医生来评估了。本病例没有记录剖宫产用的是哪种麻醉；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The anaesthetist has come to assess her. The case does not record which anaesthetic was used for the caesarean; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 椎管内麻醉（腰麻或硬膜外）

dose.zh-CN: 腰麻或硬膜外麻醉下剖宫产，或产程中硬膜外分娩镇痛。
dose.en: A spinal or epidural for the caesarean, or an epidural for labour analgesia.

harm.zh-CN: 她的血小板只有个位数：椎管内操作有硬膜外血肿致截瘫的风险。SOAP 2021共识认为血小板≥70×10⁹/L时风险很低，但只适用于妊娠期血小板减少、免疫性血小板减少症和妊娠期高血压疾病且无其他危险因素者，不包括TTP；在这个计数下应选择全身麻醉。
harm.en: Her platelet count is in single figures: a neuraxial procedure risks an epidural haematoma and paraplegia. The SOAP 2021 consensus finds the risk very low at ≥ 70×10⁹/L only in gestational thrombocytopenia, immune thrombocytopenia and hypertensive disorders without other risk factors — not TTP; at this count she needs general anaesthesia.

dose.zh-CN: 在手术室行剖宫产，按团队制定的麻醉方案；新生儿团队到场。
dose.en: Caesarean section in theatre, with the anaesthetic the team has planned; the neonatal team present.

harm.zh-CN: 在血浆置换开始之前手术，TTP完全没有得到治疗；她的血小板只有个位数——单次置换也纠正不了——任何手术都有大出血的风险。入院时没有记录到必须立即娩出的母胎情况：应先开始血浆置换，待母体稳定后再分娩（ACOG 2020：子痫前期有重度表现时，在母体稳定后终止妊娠）；不能等待的手术是否需要输注血小板，由血液科与麻醉科共同决定。
harm.en: Operating before plasma exchange has even started leaves the TTP untreated, and her count is in single figures — which one exchange does not correct either — so any operation risks major bleeding. Nothing recorded at admission forces an immediate delivery: start plasma exchange and deliver once she is stable (ACOG 2020: with severe features of pre-eclampsia, deliver once the mother is stable); platelet cover for an operation that cannot wait is decided jointly by haematology and anaesthesia.

response.zh-CN: 她被送往手术室。原报告记录她经剖宫产分娩；本病例没有记录手术距入院多久、手术指征、麻醉方式和新生儿情况。
response.en: She is taken to theatre. The report records that she was delivered by caesarean section; this case does not record how long after admission it was done, its indication, the anaesthetic or the baby's condition.

name.en: Ask the neonatal team to attend the birth

dose.zh-CN: 向新生儿团队交代母亲的病情，请他们到手术室，出生后评估新生儿。
dose.en: Hand over the mother's illness and ask the neonatal team to attend theatre and assess the baby after birth.

response.zh-CN: 新生儿团队会到场。新生儿的情况本病例没有记录。
response.en: The neonatal team will attend. The baby's condition is not recorded in this case.

dose.zh-CN: 联系ICU，转入重症监护室继续治疗和器官支持。
dose.en: Call ICU and transfer her for continued treatment and organ support.

response.zh-CN: ICU已接收，她被转入重症监护室。
response.en: ICU accepts her and she is moved to intensive care.

dose.zh-CN: 按血液科意见：375 mg/m²，每周1次，共4次；在当日血浆置换结束后输注。
dose.en: As haematology advises: 375 mg/m² once weekly for 4 doses, given after that day's plasma exchange.

response.zh-CN: 已安排输注。本病例没有记录是否用过利妥昔单抗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is arranged. The case does not record whether rituximab was given; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.9 mg/kg（最大90 mg），其中10%静脉推注，其余60分钟内滴完。
dose.en: 0.9 mg/kg (maximum 90 mg): 10% as an IV bolus, the rest over 60 minutes.

harm.zh-CN: 血小板只有个位数（分娩后还有新鲜的剖宫产切口），不能静脉溶栓（AHA/ASA 2026急性缺血性卒中指南；血小板<100×10⁹/L历来是溶栓的排除条件），溶栓可致致命出血。TTP的脑缺血来自血小板–血管性血友病因子微血栓，治疗靠血浆置换。
harm.en: A single-figure platelet count — and, after the birth, a fresh caesarean wound — puts IV thrombolysis out of the question (AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischaemic stroke guideline; a count below 100×10⁹/L has long been an exclusion): lysis risks fatal bleeding. The ischaemia of TTP comes from platelet–von Willebrand factor microthrombi, which plasma exchange treats.

name.zh-CN: 去甲肾上腺素持续泵入

dose.zh-CN: 经中心静脉持续泵入，滴定至平均动脉压≥65 mmHg。
dose.en: Continuous infusion through a central line, titrated to a mean arterial pressure of ≥ 65 mmHg.

response.zh-CN: 已泵入。原报告记录她需要升压药支持；本病例没有记录药名和剂量，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Running. The report records vasopressor support; this case does not record the drug or the dose, and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 召开家庭会议，讨论病情和治疗目标
name.en: Hold a family meeting about her condition and goals of care

dose.zh-CN: 在安静的房间，由上级医生、血液科医生和责任护士一起，按SPIKES步骤沟通：了解家属已知道什么，坦诚说明病情和不确定性，询问她本人的意愿，共同商定下一步。
dose.en: In a quiet room with the senior doctor, the haematologist and her nurse, follow SPIKES: find out what the family knows, explain her condition and the uncertainty honestly, ask what she would have wanted, and agree the next steps together.

response.zh-CN: 家属已经到齐，谈话开始。本病例没有记录医生和家属谈了什么。
response.en: The family has gathered and the conversation begins. The case does not record what was said with the family.

title.zh-CN: 问清这次发病和孕期情况
title.en: Take the history of this illness and pregnancy

hint.zh-CN: 头痛、眼睛的问题和麻木各是什么时候、怎样出现的？这是第几次怀孕，以前产检的血压和尿蛋白怎么样？还有哪些危险信号要追问？
hint.en: When and how did the headache, the eye symptoms and the numbness come on? Which pregnancy is this, and what did earlier check-ups show for her blood pressure and urine? Which other warning symptoms should you ask about?

guidance.zh-CN: 她清醒，能自己回答问题。
guidance.en: She is alert and answers for herself.

title.zh-CN: 查体并看首批检查结果
title.en: Examine her and read the first results

hint.zh-CN: 她的面色、皮肤、血压和胎心告诉你什么？把血常规、凝血、肾功能、肝功能和尿常规放在一起看，哪些结果用子痫前期解释不了？
hint.en: What do her colour, her skin, her blood pressure and the fetal heart tell you? Put the blood count, clotting, renal and liver tests and urinalysis side by side — which results does pre-eclampsia fail to explain?

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁查体；血标本在床旁留取，结果可在病历终端或床旁查看。
guidance.en: Examine her at the bedside; bloods are taken there, and results are read at a records terminal or at the bedside.

title.en: Name the problem and send the right tests

hint.zh-CN: 什么病能同时解释个位数的血小板、明显贫血、神经症状和肾损害，而凝血正常？哪个标本必须在输任何血浆之前留取？
hint.en: Which condition explains single-figure platelets, marked anaemia, neurological symptoms and renal injury with normal clotting — and which sample must be taken before any plasma is given?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策 1，并送检需要的血液学检查。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board and send the blood tests it calls for.

title.zh-CN: 分娩前的治疗与分娩安排
title.en: Treat her and plan the birth

hint.zh-CN: 哪种治疗要在确诊之前就开始？哪些看似有帮助的处理在这里反而有害？分娩的时机、方式和麻醉怎样配合她的血小板？
hint.en: Which treatment starts before the diagnosis is confirmed? Which helpful-looking steps would do harm here? How do the timing, the mode of birth and the anaesthetic fit her platelet count?

guidance.zh-CN: 她仍在孕37+1周，宝宝还在宫内。
guidance.en: She is still pregnant at 37+1 weeks.

hint.zh-CN: 分娩以后哪些结果在好转，哪些在变坏？这种变化更像会自行消退的病，还是需要升级治疗的病？她现在应该在哪里接受治疗？
hint.en: After the birth, which results are improving and which are getting worse? Does the pattern fit a disease that settles by itself, or one that needs treatment stepped up — and where should she be treated now?

guidance.zh-CN: 她已经剖宫产分娩，家属陪在床旁。
guidance.en: She has had her caesarean, and a relative is with her.

title.zh-CN: 与家属商量，并回看原报告的结局
title.en: Talk with the family and review the reported outcome

hint.zh-CN: 家属现在知道什么、最怕什么？她本人会怎么选？谈完以后，把原报告的处理经过和你的处理比一比。
hint.en: What does the family know, and what do they fear most? What would she have chosen? Afterwards, compare the report's course with what you did.

guidance.zh-CN: 她在重症监护室，家属守在床旁。
guidance.en: She is in intensive care, with her family at the bedside.

prompt.zh-CN: 21岁初产妇，孕37+1周：头痛、眼花1天，曾有左侧肢体麻木约20分钟后自行缓解；起病时血压140/100 mmHg、尿蛋白++（早先一次产检138/90 mmHg、尿蛋白阴性），入院血压120/79 mmHg。神志清楚，贫血貌，无出血点或瘀斑，体温36.2 ℃，胎心145次/分。血红蛋白66 g/L，血小板6×10⁹/L，凝血常规正常，肌酐115 μmol/L，ALT 51 U/L，尿红细胞+++、尿蛋白++。你的工作诊断是什么？
prompt.en: A 21-year-old in her first pregnancy at 37+1 weeks: a day of headache and visual disturbance, and an episode of left-sided limb numbness that settled after about 20 minutes. BP 140/100 mmHg with urine protein ++ at onset (138/90 mmHg with negative protein at an earlier check-up); 120/79 mmHg on admission. Alert, pale, no petechiae or bruising, temperature 36.2 °C, fetal heart rate 145/min. Haemoglobin 66 g/L, platelets 6×10⁹/L, routine coagulation normal, creatinine 115 μmol/L, ALT 51 U/L, urine red cells +++ and protein ++. What is your working diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先问清病史、完成查体，并看过血常规、凝血、肾功能、肝功能和尿常规。
need.en: Take the history, examine her, and read the blood count, clotting, renal and liver tests and urinalysis first.

text.zh-CN: 血栓性微血管病，在排除之前按TTP对待，同时不排除重度子痫前期：立即查血涂片、LDH和溶血指标，并在输任何血浆前留ADAMTS13标本
text.en: A thrombotic microangiopathy, treated as TTP until proved otherwise, with severe pre-eclampsia not excluded: a blood film, LDH and haemolysis tests now, and an ADAMTS13 sample before any plasma

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血小板低到个位数、血红蛋白66 g/L、神经系统症状和肾功能受损，而凝血正常、ALT只是轻度升高，这种组合首先要想到血栓性微血管病，尤其是TTP，并由血涂片确认微血管病性溶血；它可以与重度子痫前期并存，但分娩不能治愈TTP。ISTH 2020诊断指南要求先评估临床可能性并做ADAMTS13检测，中国TTP指南（2022）以活性<10%支持诊断，并在送检的同时开始治疗。
feedback.en: Right. A single-figure platelet count, a haemoglobin of 66 g/L, neurological symptoms and renal impairment with normal clotting and an ALT barely raised point first to a thrombotic microangiopathy, above all TTP, with the film to confirm the microangiopathic haemolysis; it can coexist with severe pre-eclampsia, but delivery does not cure TTP. The ISTH 2020 diagnosis guideline asks for an assessment of clinical probability and ADAMTS13 testing, and the 2022 Chinese guideline takes activity below 10% as supporting TTP and starts treatment as the sample goes off.

text.zh-CN: HELLP综合征（孕晚期溶血、ALT升高、血小板极低）：用硫酸镁，查血涂片和LDH证实溶血，输注血小板为手术做准备，今天就终止妊娠
text.en: HELLP syndrome — haemolysis, a raised ALT and very low platelets in late pregnancy: magnesium sulfate, a blood film and LDH to confirm the haemolysis, platelets to cover the operation, and delivery today

feedback.zh-CN: 查血涂片和LDH是对的，但HELLP以肝酶明显升高为特征（ACOG 2020：AST、ALT超过正常上限2倍，LDH≥600 IU/L），而她的ALT只有51 U/L、凝血正常，血小板却低到个位数，还有局灶性神经症状和明显贫血，这更符合TTP。为手术输注血小板会加重微血栓（BSH 2023），在TTP未治疗时今天就分娩，会推迟她真正需要的血浆置换。
feedback.en: The film and LDH are right, but HELLP is marked by clearly raised liver enzymes (ACOG 2020: AST and ALT more than twice the upper limit, LDH ≥ 600 IU/L), while her ALT is 51 U/L and her clotting normal with platelets in single figures, a focal neurological episode and marked anaemia — a picture that fits TTP better. Platelets to cover the operation feed the microthrombi (BSH 2023), and delivering today with TTP untreated puts off the plasma exchange she needs.

text.zh-CN: 妊娠合并免疫性血小板减少症，贫血另有原因：查血涂片，予静脉免疫球蛋白和泼尼松，并输注血小板到50×10⁹/L，以便在椎管内麻醉下安全分娩
text.en: Immune thrombocytopenia of pregnancy, with the anaemia from another cause: a blood film, IVIG and prednisolone, and platelets transfused up to 50×10⁹/L so that she can be delivered under a regional block

feedback.zh-CN: 查血涂片是对的，但免疫性血小板减少症只能解释血小板低，解释不了这么重的贫血、一过性肢体麻木、肾功能受损和蛋白尿。单用静脉免疫球蛋白和泼尼松、不做血浆置换，治不了血栓性微血管病；为了椎管内麻醉输注血小板、在这个计数下穿刺，两方面都可能造成伤害（BSH 2023；SOAP 2021）。
feedback.en: A film is right, but immune thrombocytopenia explains only the low platelets — not anaemia this severe, the transient limb numbness, the renal impairment or the proteinuria. IVIG and prednisolone without plasma exchange do not treat a thrombotic microangiopathy, and transfusing platelets to place a regional block at this count could do harm twice over (BSH 2023; SOAP 2021).

text.zh-CN: 伴神经系统受累的重度子痫前期：用硫酸镁、控制血压，查血涂片和LDH，母体稳定后终止妊娠，产后血小板仍不恢复时再考虑血浆治疗
text.en: Pre-eclampsia with severe features and neurological involvement: magnesium sulfate, blood-pressure control, a blood film and LDH, delivery once she is stable, and plasma treatment only if the count fails to recover after the birth

feedback.zh-CN: 她确实符合子痫前期的重度表现（ACOG 2020：血小板<100×10⁹/L、肌酐>97 μmol/L、新发头痛和视觉障碍），用硫酸镁、查涂片和LDH也合理——不过入院血压120/79 mmHg，现在不需要降压。但子痫前期很少使血小板降到个位数而凝血完全正常、血红蛋白只有66 g/L；等产后血小板仍不恢复才用血浆，会漏掉需要紧急血浆置换的TTP，而分娩不能治愈TTP。
feedback.en: She does meet severe features of pre-eclampsia (ACOG 2020: platelets < 100×10⁹/L, creatinine > 97 μmol/L, new headache and visual disturbance), and magnesium, the film and LDH are reasonable — though at 120/79 mmHg her blood pressure needs no treatment now. But pre-eclampsia rarely drives the platelets into single figures with entirely normal clotting and a haemoglobin of 66 g/L, and keeping plasma until the count fails after the birth misses the TTP that needs emergency plasma exchange — delivery does not cure TTP.

prompt.zh-CN: 你把血栓性微血管病（TTP可能性大）作为工作诊断。她孕37+1周，血小板6×10⁹/L，血红蛋白66 g/L。分娩前的这几个小时，你怎么处理？
prompt.en: You are treating this as a thrombotic microangiopathy, TTP likely. She is 37+1 weeks, with platelets 6×10⁹/L and haemoglobin 66 g/L. What do you do in the next few hours, before delivery?

text.zh-CN: 留取ADAMTS13标本后立即开始以血浆为置换液的血浆置换，静滴甲泼尼龙1 g/d；除非出现危及生命的出血，不输血小板；用硫酸镁；严密监护
text.en: Send the ADAMTS13 sample, then start emergency plasma exchange with plasma and methylprednisolone 1 g IV daily; no platelet transfusion unless bleeding is life-threatening; magnesium sulfate; close monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ISTH 2020治疗指南强烈推荐血浆置换联合糖皮质激素（2025年重点更新对免疫性TTP的推荐没有改变）；BSH 2023从1.5倍血浆容量的置换开始，甲泼尼龙1 g/d连用3天，并避免输注血小板。中国TTP指南（2022）在送检ADAMTS13的同时就开始血浆置换和激素，不等结果。开始置换所依据的，是急查血涂片证实微血管病性溶血伴血小板减少，并因局灶性症状做头颅CT排除出血；本病例没有记录入院时的涂片结果。
feedback.en: Right. ISTH 2020 strongly recommends plasma exchange with corticosteroids (its 2025 focused update left the immune-TTP recommendations unchanged); BSH 2023 starts with 1.5 plasma-volume exchanges, gives methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 3 days and avoids platelet transfusion. The 2022 Chinese guideline starts plasma exchange and steroids as the ADAMTS13 sample goes off, without waiting for the result. Starting exchange does need an urgent film showing microangiopathic haemolysis with the low count, and a head CT for her focal symptoms to exclude bleeding; this case records no admission film result.

text.zh-CN: 立即输注血小板，并反复输注使计数一直保持在50×10⁹/L以上，为分娩和手术做好准备；如果计数仍升不上去，再开始血浆治疗；用硫酸镁；严密监护
text.en: Transfuse platelets now and keep repeating them to hold the count above 50×10⁹/L in readiness for delivery and surgery, starting plasma treatment only if the count fails to rise; magnesium sulfate; close monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近原报告中反复输注血小板的做法。BSH 2023建议TTP中避免输注血小板，除非出现危及生命的出血：输入的血小板会被微血管血栓消耗，观察性数据提示它与动脉血栓和死亡增加相关，而真正的治疗——血浆置换——却被推迟了。
feedback.en: This is close to the report's repeated platelet transfusions. BSH 2023 advises avoiding platelet transfusion in TTP unless bleeding is life-threatening: transfused platelets are consumed in the microvascular thrombi, observational data link them with arterial thrombosis and death, and the real treatment — plasma exchange — is put off.

text.zh-CN: 先输注新鲜冰冻血浆补充ADAMTS13，等检测结果确诊以后再安排有创的血浆置换，静滴甲泼尼龙1 g/d；用硫酸镁；严密监护
text.en: Infuse fresh frozen plasma now to replace ADAMTS13, and wait for the test result to confirm the diagnosis before booking an invasive plasma exchange; methylprednisolone 1 g IV daily; magnesium sulfate; close monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 单纯输注血浆不能代替血浆置换：1991年加拿大随机试验中血浆置换优于血浆输注，单纯输注还受到容量负荷的限制。ADAMTS13结果往往需要数天，临床高度怀疑时应立即置换，不等结果（ISTH 2020；中国TTP指南2022）。
feedback.en: Plasma infusion is no substitute for plasma exchange: in the 1991 Canadian randomised trial exchange did better than infusion, and infusion alone is limited by the fluid it adds. ADAMTS13 results can take days, and with a high clinical suspicion exchange starts without waiting (ISTH 2020; Chinese guideline 2022).

text.zh-CN: 先终止妊娠，因为子痫前期和HELLP都会在分娩后缓解，产后再根据血象的变化决定要不要血浆治疗；用硫酸镁；严密监护
text.en: Deliver her first, since pre-eclampsia and HELLP settle after the birth, and decide on plasma treatment from how the blood count behaves afterwards; magnesium sulfate; close monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 子痫前期和HELLP会在分娩后缓解，TTP却不会因分娩而停止；在血小板只有个位数、TTP还没有治疗时手术，风险极高。ACOG 2020也要求先稳定母体再终止妊娠——对她来说，稳定的关键就是血浆置换。
feedback.en: Pre-eclampsia and HELLP settle after the birth, but delivery does not switch TTP off, and operating with single-figure platelets and untreated TTP is very dangerous. ACOG 2020 also stabilises the mother before delivery — and for her, stabilisation means plasma exchange.

prompt.zh-CN: 血浆置换已经开始。她孕37+1周，胎心145次/分；最近一次记录的血小板为6×10⁹/L，置换后的血小板计数没有记录。你怎样安排分娩？
prompt.en: Plasma exchange has started. She is 37+1 weeks and the fetal heart rate is 145/min; her last recorded platelet count is 6×10⁹/L, and no count after exchange is recorded. How do you plan the birth?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，开始它要求的治疗，并听过胎心。
need.en: Answer decision 2, start the treatment it calls for, and listen to the fetal heart first.

text.zh-CN: 血浆置换后病情稳定即足月分娩，期间胎心监护；分娩方式按产科指征，剖宫产用全身麻醉，不做腰麻或硬膜外；不常规预防性输注血小板；新生儿团队到场
text.en: Deliver at term once she is stable on plasma exchange, with a CTG meanwhile; mode by obstetric indication, and general anaesthesia with no spinal or epidural for a caesarean; no routine platelet cover; neonatal team present

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。孕37周、有子痫前期重度表现时，应在母体稳定后分娩（ACOG 2020）——对她来说，稳定是指每日血浆置换后血小板回升、神经症状平稳，而本病例没有记录这些；分娩方式按产科指征。SOAP 2021共识认为血小板≥70×10⁹/L时椎管内阻滞风险很低，但只适用于妊娠期血小板减少、ITP和妊娠期高血压疾病，个位数的计数下剖宫产应选全身麻醉。血小板不常规输注（BSH 2023）；置换开始后，不能等待的手术是否需要输注血小板，由血液科和麻醉科共同决定。
feedback.en: Right. At 37 weeks with severe features of pre-eclampsia, delivery follows maternal stabilisation (ACOG 2020): here that means a platelet count rising on daily exchange and settled neurology, which this case does not record, and the mode follows obstetric indications. The SOAP 2021 consensus finds neuraxial risk very low at ≥ 70×10⁹/L only in gestational thrombocytopenia, ITP and hypertensive disorders, so at a single-figure count a caesarean needs general anaesthesia. Platelets are not given routinely (BSH 2023); cover for an operation that cannot wait, once exchange is under way, is a joint haematology–anaesthesia decision.

text.zh-CN: 今天就在腰麻下剖宫产：先输血小板把计数提到50×10⁹/L，因为腰麻可以避免全身麻醉的插管和气道风险，产后血象也会恢复；期间做胎心监护；新生儿团队到场
text.en: Caesarean today under a spinal, after platelets bring the count to 50×10⁹/L, since a spinal spares her the intubation and airway risks of general anaesthesia and the count will recover after the delivery; a CTG meanwhile; the neonatal team present

feedback.zh-CN: 腰麻需要足够的血小板数量和功能：SOAP 2021的≥70×10⁹/L低风险阈值不适用于TTP，用输注把个位数的计数提到50×10⁹/L也不能保证安全，硬膜外血肿可致截瘫；反复输注血小板在TTP中本身就应避免（BSH 2023）。
feedback.en: A spinal needs an adequate platelet count and function: the SOAP 2021 low-risk threshold of ≥ 70×10⁹/L does not cover TTP, transfusing a single-figure count up to 50×10⁹/L does not make it safe, and an epidural haematoma can cause paraplegia; repeated platelet transfusion is itself to be avoided in TTP (BSH 2023).

text.zh-CN: 在血浆置换下继续妊娠到40周，因为分娩不能治疗TTP；每周胎心监护和胎儿生长超声，只在临产或出现胎儿窘迫时分娩；新生儿团队到场
text.en: Continue the pregnancy to 40 weeks on plasma exchange, since delivery does not treat TTP; weekly CTGs and growth scans, delivering only for labour or fetal compromise; neonatal team present

feedback.zh-CN: TTP本身确实不靠分娩治疗，但她同时有子痫前期的重度表现（血压升高伴蛋白尿、头痛、视觉障碍、肌酐升高），ACOG 2020建议孕34周以后在母体稳定后分娩；足月后继续妊娠对胎儿没有好处，只会延长母体的风险。
feedback.en: TTP itself is not treated by delivery, but she also has severe features of pre-eclampsia (raised blood pressure with proteinuria, headache, visual disturbance, raised creatinine), and ACOG 2020 recommends delivery after 34 weeks once the mother is stable; continuing at term offers the baby nothing and prolongs the risk to the mother.

text.zh-CN: 现在引产，输血小板到80×10⁹/L后尽早放置硬膜外导管，这样如需剖宫产可以经硬膜外追加麻醉；期间胎心监护；新生儿团队到场
text.en: Induce labour now and site an early epidural once platelet transfusions reach 80×10⁹/L, so that the epidural can be topped up for any caesarean; a CTG meanwhile; neonatal team present

feedback.zh-CN: 引产本身可以考虑，但硬膜外置管同样受血小板数量的限制：SOAP 2021的阈值不适用于TTP，靠输注血小板达到80×10⁹/L既不可靠，又违背TTP中避免输注血小板的建议（BSH 2023）。
feedback.en: Induction itself can be considered, but an epidural catheter is limited by the platelet count in the same way: the SOAP 2021 threshold does not cover TTP, and transfusing up to 80×10⁹/L is both unreliable and against the advice to avoid platelet transfusion in TTP (BSH 2023).

prompt.zh-CN: 剖宫产后：她仍反复意识不清；此后血小板最低8×10⁹/L；LDH 1600 U/L，之后4880 U/L；肌酐最高268 μmol/L；头颅MRI（检查时间未记录）见多发急性缺血病灶。你现在怎么判断、怎么处理？
prompt.en: After the caesarean she still has recurrent impaired consciousness; the lowest platelet count since is 8×10⁹/L; LDH 1600 U/L, later 4880 U/L; creatinine up to 268 μmol/L; and a brain MRI (timing not recorded) shows multiple acute ischaemic lesions. How do you read this, and what now?

need.zh-CN: 先评估她的意识状态，并看产后的血常规、LDH、肾功能和头颅MRI。
need.en: Assess her conscious level and read the post-delivery blood count, LDH, renal function and brain MRI first.

text.zh-CN: 分娩后病情仍在进展：每日血浆置换加激素，与血液科商定加用利妥昔单抗，不输血小板，转ICU；若ADAMTS13不是重度降低，再评估补体介导的TMA
text.en: Delivery has not switched it off: daily plasma exchange with steroids, rituximab with haematology, no platelets, transfer to ICU; if ADAMTS13 proves not severely low, reassess for complement-mediated TMA

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。剖宫产后LDH由1600升到4880 U/L，血小板最低8×10⁹/L，肌酐升到268 μmol/L，意识反复不清，MRI又见多发急性缺血病灶，说明微血管病性溶血和器官损害没有随分娩缓解，不是正在消退的HELLP。ISTH 2020推荐血浆置换加糖皮质激素，并有条件推荐加用利妥昔单抗和卡普赛珠单抗（caplacizumab）（2025年更新未改）；是否用卡普赛珠单抗由血液科权衡她新鲜的手术切口、出血风险、哺乳和药物可及性后决定；BSH 2023强调避免输注血小板。ADAMTS13活性>20%时TTP基本可以排除，应评估补体介导的TMA（中国TTP指南2022）。
feedback.en: Right. After the caesarean LDH rose from 1600 to 4880 U/L, the lowest count was 8×10⁹/L, creatinine reached 268 μmol/L and she still had recurrent impaired consciousness, and the MRI shows multiple acute ischaemic lesions: the microangiopathic haemolysis and organ injury have not settled with the birth — this is not a HELLP that is burning out. ISTH 2020 recommends plasma exchange with corticosteroids and conditionally adds rituximab and caplacizumab (unchanged in 2025; caplacizumab is a haematology decision that weighs her fresh wound, its bleeding risk, breastfeeding and availability), and BSH 2023 stresses avoiding platelet transfusion. With ADAMTS13 activity above 20% TTP is essentially excluded and complement-mediated TMA is assessed (Chinese TTP guideline 2022).

text.zh-CN: 继续输注新鲜冰冻血浆，并反复输注血小板直到计数恢复，因为现在最大的危险是剖宫产切口和腹腔出血；在病房观察意识变化，下周复查头颅MRI
text.en: Keep giving fresh frozen plasma with repeated platelet transfusions until the count recovers, since bleeding from the caesarean wound and the abdomen is the main danger now; watch her conscious level on the ward and repeat the MRI next week

feedback.zh-CN: 这接近原报告的实际做法：输注新鲜冰冻血浆、反复输注血小板；本病例没有记录血浆置换。血浆输注不能代替置换（1991年加拿大随机试验），TTP中应避免输注血小板（BSH 2023）；她现在最大的危险是微血管血栓造成的脑、心、肾损害，而不是切口出血。
feedback.en: This is close to what the report's team did — fresh frozen plasma and repeated platelet transfusions; this case records no plasma exchange. Plasma infusion does not replace exchange (the 1991 Canadian randomised trial) and platelets are avoided in TTP (BSH 2023); her greatest danger now is microvascular thrombosis in the brain, heart and kidneys, not wound bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 这是产后HELLP，常在分娩后24–48小时达到高峰，之后自行好转：硫酸镁维持24小时、支持治疗、每天复查血常规，72小时仍无好转再考虑血浆治疗
text.en: This is postpartum HELLP, which often peaks 24–48 hours after delivery and then settles by itself: magnesium for 24 hours, supportive care and daily counts, with plasma treatment only if she is no better at 72 hours

feedback.zh-CN: HELLP的化验异常可在产后头一两天加重，但她已出现多发急性脑缺血、反复意识不清、个位数血小板和持续上升的LDH，不能再等72小时。TTP在分娩后常持续甚至加重，每延误一天都可能造成新的器官损害；应立即每日血浆置换（ISTH 2020；BSH 2023）。
feedback.en: HELLP abnormalities can worsen over the first day or two after delivery, but with multiple acute cerebral ischaemic lesions, recurrent impaired consciousness, single-figure platelets and a still-rising LDH she cannot wait 72 hours. TTP often persists or worsens after delivery, and each day of delay risks new organ damage; daily plasma exchange starts now (ISTH 2020; BSH 2023).

text.zh-CN: MRI提示急性缺血性卒中：先输血小板把计数提上来，在时间窗内静脉阿替普酶溶栓，之后长期口服阿司匹林，由卒中团队接管她的后续治疗
text.en: Acute ischaemic stroke on the MRI: platelets first to bring the count up, then IV alteplase within the time window and long-term aspirin afterwards, with the stroke team taking over her care

feedback.zh-CN: 血小板只有个位数、剖宫产切口又是新鲜的，静脉溶栓根本无从谈起（AHA/ASA 2026急性缺血性卒中指南；血小板<100×10⁹/L历来是溶栓的排除条件），为了溶栓去输血小板只会加重TTP。TTP的脑缺血来自血小板–血管性血友病因子微血栓，治疗是血浆置换，不是溶栓或抗血小板药。
feedback.en: A single-figure count with a fresh caesarean wound puts IV thrombolysis out of the question (AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischaemic stroke guideline; a count below 100×10⁹/L has long been an exclusion), and transfusing platelets to make lysis possible would feed the TTP. The ischaemia of TTP comes from platelet–von Willebrand factor microthrombi; the treatment is plasma exchange, not lysis or antiplatelet drugs.

text.zh-CN: 分娩后出现急性肾损伤，是产后非典型溶血尿毒综合征：停止血浆置换，改用依库珠单抗，因为补体阻断才是治疗，ADAMTS13检测可以省去
text.en: Kidney injury after delivery makes this postpartum atypical HUS: stop plasma exchange and start eculizumab, as complement blockade is the treatment and ADAMTS13 testing can be skipped

feedback.zh-CN: 分娩后确实可以发生补体介导的TMA，但她的血小板降到个位数并有多发脑缺血，更符合TTP，在ADAMTS13结果出来之前不能停止血浆置换。中国TTP指南（2022）以活性<10%支持TTP、>20%基本排除；只有排除TTP以后，补体抑制剂才成为主要治疗。
feedback.en: Complement-mediated TMA can follow delivery, but single-figure platelets with multiple cerebral ischaemic lesions fit TTP better, and plasma exchange cannot stop before ADAMTS13 is known. The 2022 Chinese guideline takes activity below 10% as supporting TTP and above 20% as essentially excluding it; complement inhibition becomes the main treatment only once TTP has been excluded.

prompt.zh-CN: 在重症监护室：心力衰竭，气管插管，深昏迷，需要升压药维持循环。家属说家里在商量是不是不治了，想带她离开医院。你怎么做？
prompt.en: In intensive care: heart failure, intubated, in a deep coma, on vasopressors. Her relative says the family is talking about stopping treatment and taking her out of hospital. What do you do?

need.zh-CN: 先在床旁查看她、读ICU病程记录，并听听家属的想法。
need.en: See her at the bedside, read the ICU notes and hear what the family is thinking first.

text.zh-CN: 由ICU上级医生、血液科医生和责任护士与家属会谈：了解他们知道多少，坦诚说明血浆置换还能做什么、预后多不确定，问清她本人会怎么想，再共同决定
text.en: Meet the family with the senior intensivist, the haematologist and her nurse: learn what they understand, explain honestly what plasma exchange can still offer and how uncertain her outlook is, ask what she would want, decide together

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACCM/ATS 2016关于ICU共同决策的政策声明要求医生与代理决策者共同确定治疗目标，包括限制或撤除生命支持；SPIKES框架帮助组织谈话：环境、了解认知、征得同意、告知信息、回应情绪、总结计划。TTP经血浆置换仍可能缓解，但她已深昏迷、心力衰竭并依赖升压药，预后高度不确定，应如实告诉家属。
feedback.en: Right. The ACCM/ATS 2016 policy statement on shared decision making in ICUs asks clinicians and surrogates to set goals of care together, including limiting or withdrawing life support; SPIKES structures the conversation — setting, perception, invitation, knowledge, emotions, strategy and summary. TTP can still remit with plasma exchange, but with deep coma, heart failure and vasopressor dependence her outlook is highly uncertain, and the family should hear that honestly.

text.zh-CN: 与家属会谈，目的是说服他们继续治疗：她才21岁，TTP是可以治愈的病，所以不能放弃；请他们签字同意全力抢救，至于她本人以前的意愿，现在先不讨论
text.en: Meet the family to persuade them to continue: she is only 21 and TTP is a curable disease, so stopping is not an option; ask them to sign consent for full treatment, and leave the question of her own earlier wishes aside for the time being

feedback.zh-CN: 这是家长式的单方面说服：把“可以治愈”说成定论，回避了她深昏迷、心力衰竭、依赖升压药的严重程度，也没有问她本人的价值观和意愿。共同决策（ACCM/ATS 2016）需要如实的预后信息和对患者意愿的探讨。
feedback.en: This is one-sided persuasion: it presents cure as certain, skips over her deep coma, heart failure and dependence on vasopressors, and never asks about her own values and wishes. Shared decision making (ACCM/ATS 2016) needs honest prognostic information and a discussion of what the patient would want.

text.zh-CN: 尊重家属的决定权：按他们的要求今天停止全部治疗、办理出院，在病历中记录已告知风险，不再安排正式谈话，以免加重他们的痛苦
text.en: Respect the family's right to decide: stop all treatment and arrange discharge today as they ask, recording in the notes that the risks were explained, without a formal meeting that would only add to their distress

feedback.zh-CN: 家属有权参与决定，但不经正式谈话就同意出院，等于放弃了告知、澄清误解和探讨她本人意愿的机会，也可能让家属在信息不全时做出难以承受的决定。即使最终决定带她离开医院，也应在会谈后作为知情决定记录，并提供安宁疗护支持（ACCM/ATS 2016）。
feedback.en: The family has a say, but agreeing to discharge without a proper meeting gives up the chance to inform them, correct misunderstandings and explore her own wishes, and may leave them making an unbearable decision on partial information. Even if they choose to take her out of hospital, it should follow a meeting, be recorded as an informed decision and come with palliative support (ACCM/ATS 2016).

text.zh-CN: 与家属会谈并建议放弃：深昏迷加上MRI多发缺血病灶，说明她已经醒不过来了，继续血浆置换和生命支持都是徒劳，可以停止治疗
text.en: Meet the family and advise stopping: deep coma with multiple ischaemic lesions on the MRI means she will not wake up, so further plasma exchange and life support would be futile and should be withdrawn

feedback.zh-CN: 单凭深昏迷和MRI多发缺血灶，不能断定她“醒不过来”：TTP的神经系统损害经血浆置换有时可以恢复，而本病例没有记录任何足以判断预后的神经系统评估。在缺乏依据时下“徒劳”的结论，会让家属在错误的信息上做决定（ACCM/ATS 2016）。
feedback.en: Deep coma and multiple ischaemic lesions on MRI do not by themselves show she will never wake: neurological damage in TTP sometimes recovers with plasma exchange, and the case records no neurological assessment that could settle her prognosis. Calling treatment futile without that evidence asks the family to decide on wrong information (ACCM/ATS 2016).

text.zh-CN: 问清头痛与眼花、一过性肢体麻木、孕周与胎次以及入院前的血压和尿蛋白，并追问出血、抽搐或无力、上腹痛、胎动、用药和过敏
text.en: Took the history of the headache and visual disturbance, the transient limb numbness, the gestation and parity and the blood pressure and urine protein before admission, and asked about bleeding, fits or weakness, upper abdominal pain, fetal movements, medicines and allergies

text.zh-CN: 查看神志和面色、皮肤出血点和瘀斑、生命体征和胎心
text.en: Examined her conscious level and colour, her skin for petechiae and bruising, her vital signs and the fetal heart

text.zh-CN: 看过就诊时的血常规、凝血、肾功能和尿常规，并在入院阶段送检血涂片、LDH和ADAMTS13标本
text.en: Read the presenting blood count, clotting, renal function and urinalysis, and sent a blood film, LDH and the ADAMTS13 sample in the admission phase

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把血栓性微血管病（TTP）列为工作诊断（决策 1）
text.en: Made a thrombotic microangiopathy (TTP) the working diagnosis at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择分娩前立即血浆置换加激素、不输血小板（决策 2）
text.en: Chose immediate plasma exchange with steroids and no platelet transfusion before delivery, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 开始血浆置换并给予甲泼尼龙
text.en: Started plasma exchange and gave methylprednisolone

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定安全的分娩方案，并请麻醉医生和新生儿团队参与（决策 3）
text.en: Planned a safe birth at the first attempt and involved the anaesthetist and the neonatal team (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 没有输注血小板，没有做椎管内麻醉，也没有静脉溶栓
text.en: Gave no platelet transfusion, no spinal or epidural and no thrombolysis

text.zh-CN: 血压未达用药指征时没有静脉降压，在可以做血浆置换时也没有另外输注血浆
text.en: Gave no IV antihypertensive at a blood pressure that did not call for one, and no separate plasma infusion when plasma exchange was available

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断分娩后病情仍在进展并升级治疗：转ICU、继续血浆置换（决策 4）
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that the disease was progressing after delivery, and escalated: ICU transfer and continued plasma exchange (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择与家属共同决策，并召开家庭会议（决策 5）
text.en: Chose shared decision making with the family at the first attempt and held a family meeting (decision 5)

text.zh-CN: 按SPIKES框架与家属沟通她的病情、治疗选择和不确定的预后
text.en: Talked with the family about her condition, the treatment options and the uncertain outlook, using SPIKES

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按SPIKES评价与家属的谈话：S（环境）——安静的房间，上级医生、血液科医生和责任护士在场，关掉手机，先问家属愿意谁参加；P（了解认知）——先问他们对她的病知道多少，再补充；I（征得同意）——问他们想知道多少细节；K（告知信息）——用通俗的话说明：这是一种让全身小血管里形成血栓的血液病，医生高度怀疑是TTP，但确诊的检查（ADAMTS13）还没有结果；血浆置换是主要治疗，有时神经系统损害也能恢复；但她现在深昏迷、心脏衰竭、靠升压药维持，预后高度不确定，不作虚假保证，也不武断地说“没希望”；E（回应情绪）——承认家属的悲痛和疲惫，留出沉默和提问的时间；S（总结计划）——一起讨论她本人会怎么想，说明可选的路（继续治疗并设定复评时间点、限制升级，或在知情后带她离开医院并安排安宁疗护），尊重家属的决定并记录。还要提到孩子由谁照顾、家属能得到哪些支持。请家属复述关键内容以确认理解。本病例没有记录与家属的谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation with the family by SPIKES: S (setting) — a quiet room, the senior doctor, the haematologist and her nurse present, phones off, asking who the family wants there; P (perception) — first ask what they understand of her illness, then build on it; I (invitation) — ask how much detail they want; K (knowledge) — in plain words: a blood disorder that makes clots form in the small blood vessels all over the body, most likely TTP, though the confirming test (ADAMTS13) has no result yet; plasma exchange is the main treatment and neurological damage sometimes recovers; but she is in a deep coma, her heart is failing and she depends on vasopressors, so the outlook is highly uncertain — no false reassurance, and no flat 'there is no hope'; E (emotions) — acknowledge their grief and exhaustion and leave room for silence and questions; S (strategy and summary) — discuss together what she would have wanted, lay out the paths (continue with a set point to review, limit escalation, or take her out of hospital after an informed decision, with palliative support), respect and record their decision. Ask who is caring for the baby and what support the family has. Check understanding by teach-back. This case does not record a conversation with the family.

name.zh-CN: 岑医生（产科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“血小板降到个位数，而凝血完全正常，你会想到哪几类病？”“TTP和重度子痫前期能不能同时存在？分娩能治好哪一个？”“哪个标本必须在输任何血浆之前留？为什么不等结果就开始治疗？”“她有局灶性症状、血小板只有6，做任何有创操作之前先要做什么影像？”“为什么这里不输血小板？”“这个血小板计数下，剖宫产用什么麻醉？”“分娩后哪些指标告诉你病情没有停下来？”“家属想放弃时，你先问什么？”。可以讲ISTH 2020、BSH 2023、中国TTP指南（2022）、ACOG 2020、SOAP 2021和ACCM/ATS 2016的相关原则。原报告的处理是历史记录，在病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；ADAMTS13、完整溶血指标、入院时的其余生命体征、头颅CT、MRI和血涂片的具体时间、新生儿情况都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'With platelets in single figures and entirely normal clotting, which groups of disease come to mind?', 'Can TTP and severe pre-eclampsia coexist — and which of them does delivery cure?', 'Which sample must be taken before any plasma, and why start treatment without waiting for its result?', 'With focal symptoms and a count of 6, what imaging comes before anything invasive?', 'Why no platelets here?', 'What anaesthetic for a caesarean at this platelet count?', 'After the birth, which results tell you the disease has not stopped?', 'When the family wants to stop, what do you ask first?'. May explain the relevant principles of ISTH 2020, BSH 2023, the 2022 Chinese TTP guideline, ACOG 2020, SOAP 2021 and ACCM/ATS 2016. The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case, and is compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; ADAMTS13, a full haemolysis panel, the other admission vital signs, the timing of the head CT, the MRI and the film, and the baby's condition are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 产科病房助产士。交班（ISBAR）：21岁，第一次怀孕，孕37+1周；头痛、眼花1天，一过性左侧肢体麻木约20分钟后缓解；入院时神志清楚，血压120/79 mmHg，体温36.2 ℃，胎心145次/分；此前查血小板7×10⁹/L。可以协助建立静脉通路、留取血标本、上胎心监护、准备硫酸镁和血制品；胎心监护仪在1号床旁，血细胞分离机在病房设备间，血制品由血库送到床旁。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（比如入院时的心率、她的体重）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Obstetric ward midwife. Handover (ISBAR): 21, first pregnancy, 37+1 weeks; a day of headache and visual disturbance, and left-sided limb numbness for about 20 minutes that settled; on admission alert, BP 120/79 mmHg, temperature 36.2 °C, fetal heart rate 145/min; an earlier platelet count of 7×10⁹/L. Can place a cannula, take bloods, put on the CTG and prepare magnesium sulfate and blood products; the CTG machine is by bed 1, the apheresis machine is in the ward equipment bay, and blood products come up from the blood bank to the bedside. Reads back orders and reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her admission heart rate, her weight).

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的血液学结果。可以讲：血栓性微血管病的要点（微血管病性溶血、血小板消耗、器官缺血）；TTP临床可能性的评估和ADAMTS13检测（活性<10%支持TTP、>20%基本可排除，标本须在输血浆前留取）；血浆置换（首次1.5倍血浆容量、以血浆为置换液、每日一次）、甲泼尼龙1 g/d×3天和利妥昔单抗的作用；卡普赛珠单抗（caplacizumab）——ISTH（2020年，2025年更新未改）有条件推荐用于已确诊、或ADAMTS13结果未出但可能性很高的免疫性TTP急性发作，必须与血浆置换和免疫抑制治疗合用；它增加出血风险，说明书建议妊娠期避免使用、哺乳期需另作决定，围产期的经验仅来自个案报道，各地可及性不同，所以是否使用由血液科决定；就诊时查肌钙蛋白和心电图，评估心脏受累；为什么避免输注血小板；免疫性与先天性TTP的区别，以及今后再次妊娠的风险和监测。不说出诊断结论，不补充病例没有记录的数值。
knowledge.en: Haematology consultant who interprets only haematology results the learner has already read. Can explain: the hallmarks of a thrombotic microangiopathy (microangiopathic haemolysis, platelet consumption, organ ischaemia); assessing the clinical probability of TTP and ADAMTS13 testing (activity below 10% supports TTP, above 20% essentially excludes it; the sample is taken before plasma); plasma exchange (1.5 plasma volumes at first, plasma as the replacement fluid, daily), methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 3 days and the place of rituximab; caplacizumab — conditionally recommended by ISTH (2020, unchanged in 2025) for an acute immune-TTP episode that is confirmed, or highly probable while ADAMTS13 is pending, always with exchange and immunosuppression; it adds bleeding risk, its labelling advises avoiding it in pregnancy and needs a decision about breastfeeding, experience around childbirth rests on case reports, and availability varies, so starting it is a haematology decision; a troponin and an ECG at presentation for cardiac involvement; why platelet transfusion is avoided; immune versus congenital TTP, and the risk and monitoring in a later pregnancy. Does not state the diagnosis and adds no values the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 樊医生（重症医学科，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: ICU医生，只解读学员已经看过的ICU资料。可以讲：TTP累及心脏和脑时的监护重点（肌钙蛋白、心电图、超声心动图，补液要谨慎——单纯输注血浆会增加容量负荷）；在ICU继续每日血浆置换；升压药和机械通气的目标；怎样组织家庭会议（SPIKES、共同决策）。本病例没有记录生命体征、呼吸机参数和升压药剂量，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: ICU consultant who interprets only ICU records the learner has read. Can explain: what to monitor when TTP involves the heart and brain (troponin, ECG, echocardiography, cautious fluids — plasma infusion adds volume); continuing daily plasma exchange in ICU; targets for vasopressors and ventilation; and how to run a family meeting (SPIKES, shared decision making). The case records no vital signs, ventilator settings or vasopressor doses — do not supply them.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：足月妊娠的血栓性微血管病（报告诊断为TTP）
title.en: Debrief: a thrombotic microangiopathy at term (reported as TTP)

conclusion.zh-CN: 21岁初产妇孕37+1周，头痛、眼花1天，一过性左侧肢体麻木约20分钟；起病时血压140/100 mmHg、尿蛋白++，入院血压120/79 mmHg。血红蛋白66 g/L，血小板6×10⁹/L（此前7×10⁹/L），凝血常规正常，肌酐115 μmol/L，ALT 51 U/L，尿红细胞+++。剖宫产后仍反复意识不清，血小板最低8×10⁹/L，LDH由1600升至4880 U/L，肌酐最高268 μmol/L；头颅MRI见多发急性缺血病灶，后续血涂片见大量破碎红细胞（两者时间均未记录）——符合血栓性微血管病；报告诊断为TTP，本病例没有记录ADAMTS13结果。原报告在后期才考虑TTP，输注新鲜冰冻血浆并反复输注血小板，没有记录血浆置换；她出现心力衰竭、气管插管、深昏迷和升压药依赖，家属最终带她离院，此后结局未记录。按现行指南：入院时就应怀疑TTP，留ADAMTS13标本后立即开始血浆置换和糖皮质激素，避免输注血小板，母体稳定后分娩（如需剖宫产则用全身麻醉），产后病情不缓解时在ICU继续置换并升级治疗。
conclusion.en: A 21-year-old primigravida at 37+1 weeks had a day of headache and visual disturbance and 20 minutes of left-sided numbness; BP 140/100 mmHg with proteinuria at onset, 120/79 mmHg on admission. Hb 66 g/L, platelets 6×10⁹/L (7 earlier), normal clotting, creatinine 115 μmol/L, ALT 51 U/L. After a caesarean she still had recurrent impaired consciousness, a lowest count of 8×10⁹/L, LDH from 1600 to 4880 U/L and creatinine to 268 μmol/L; MRI showed multiple acute ischaemic lesions and a later film many schistocytes (timing not recorded): a TMA, reported as TTP, with no ADAMTS13 result recorded. TTP was considered late: fresh frozen plasma and repeated platelets, no recorded exchange; heart failure, intubation, deep coma and vasopressors followed until her family took her away. Today: suspect TTP at admission, send ADAMTS13, start exchange with steroids, avoid platelets, deliver once stable (general anaesthesia if a caesarean is needed), and escalate when the birth fails to stop it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血小板个位数、血红蛋白66 g/L、神经症状和肾损害，而凝血正常、ALT只是轻度升高：这种组合首先是血栓性微血管病，不能全部归于子痫前期。
keyReasoning.en: Single-figure platelets, a haemoglobin of 66 g/L, neurological symptoms and renal injury, with normal clotting and an ALT barely raised: this pattern is a thrombotic microangiopathy first, not pre-eclampsia alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗等的是血涂片，而不是ADAMTS13结果：急查血涂片见到破碎红细胞即可证实微血管病性溶血（本病例没有记录入院时的涂片结果），ADAMTS13标本在输任何血浆前留取，血浆置换和激素不等其结果就开始。
keyReasoning.en: Treatment waits for the blood film, not for ADAMTS13: schistocytes on an urgent film confirm the microangiopathic haemolysis (this case records no admission film), the ADAMTS13 sample goes before any plasma, and plasma exchange with steroids starts without its result.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血小板低不等于要输血小板：在TTP中，提升计数不是目标，输注反而可能加重血栓。
keyReasoning.en: A low count is not a reason to transfuse platelets: in TTP the number is not the target, and transfusion can feed the thrombosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 把分娩前后的结果连起来看：剖宫产后仍反复意识不清，LDH由1600升至4880 U/L，血小板最低8×10⁹/L，肌酐升到268 μmol/L——病情没有随分娩缓解，不会自己消退。
keyReasoning.en: Read the course across the delivery: after the caesarean she still had recurrent impaired consciousness, LDH rose from 1600 to 4880 U/L, the lowest count was 8×10⁹/L and creatinine reached 268 μmol/L — a disease that has not settled with the birth and will not settle on its own.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录ADAMTS13结果，报告的TTP诊断只能算“高度可能”；免疫性TTP、先天性TTP和补体介导的TMA仍需鉴别。
keyReasoning.en: With no ADAMTS13 result recorded in this case, the report's TTP diagnosis is a strong probability, not a proof; immune and congenital TTP and complement-mediated TMA remain to be told apart.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 当家属考虑放弃治疗时，医生要讲清楚治疗还能带来什么、预后有多不确定，并了解她本人的意愿。
keyReasoning.en: When a family considers stopping, the clinician's task is to make clear what treatment can still offer, how uncertain the outlook is, and what she herself would have wanted.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能证明任何治疗的效果，也不能确定TTP的类型。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。头颅CT、MRI和血涂片的确切时间没有记录：本病例从入院阶段起即显示首次头颅CT，把MRI和后续血涂片放在分娩后阶段；入院化验的具体时间也没有记录，本病例把它们放在分娩前；家属在重症监护阶段表达的考虑，是依据结局记录安排的教学呈现。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show the effect of any treatment or settle which kind of TTP this was. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The exact timing of the head CT, the MRI and the blood film is not recorded: the case shows the first head CT from admission and places the MRI and the later film after the delivery; nor is the exact timing of the presenting blood results, which it places before the delivery; the family's thoughts voiced in intensive care are a teaching presentation built on the outcome record.

unknowns.zh-CN: ADAMTS13活性、抑制物（抗ADAMTS13抗体）和基因检测——TTP的类型无从确定。
unknowns.en: ADAMTS13 activity, inhibitor (anti-ADAMTS13 antibody) and genetic testing — the type of TTP cannot be settled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整的溶血指标（胆红素、网织红细胞、结合珠蛋白、直接抗人球蛋白试验），以及入院时的LDH、白细胞和红细胞指数。
unknowns.en: A full haemolysis panel (bilirubin, reticulocytes, haptoglobin, direct antiglobulin test) and the admission LDH, white cell count and red cell indices.

unknowns.zh-CN: 剖宫产的时间、指征、麻醉方式和出血量；新生儿的情况。
unknowns.en: The timing, indication, anaesthetic and blood loss of the caesarean; the baby's condition.

unknowns.zh-CN: 头颅CT、MRI和血涂片的具体时间，以及MRI病灶的部位。
unknowns.en: When the head CT, the MRI and the blood film were done, and where the MRI lesions were.

unknowns.zh-CN: 输注血小板和新鲜冰冻血浆的次数和剂量，以及是否用过硫酸镁、降压药或糖皮质激素。
unknowns.en: How many platelet and plasma transfusions she had and in what doses, and whether magnesium sulfate, antihypertensives or corticosteroids were given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（入院时的心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度和之后的全部数值）、心力衰竭的检查依据（任何阶段都没有肌钙蛋白、心电图或超声心动图结果）、呼吸机参数和升压药剂量。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (the admission heart rate, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation, and every later value), the findings behind the heart-failure diagnosis (no troponin, ECG or echocardiogram result at any stage), ventilator settings and vasopressor doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、用药、过敏史、家族史，家属放弃治疗的原因，以及她离院后的结局。
unknowns.en: Past history, medicines, allergies, family history, the family's reasons for stopping treatment, and what happened after she left.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 妊娠期TMA的鉴别：子痫前期重度表现（ACOG 2020：血小板<100×10⁹/L、肌酐>97 μmol/L、新发头痛或视觉障碍）、HELLP（ACOG 2020：LDH≥600 IU/L、AST/ALT>2倍正常上限、血小板<100×10⁹/L）与TTP可以重叠。血小板<30×10⁹/L（PLASMIC评分的一项）、明显贫血、神经症状而凝血正常、转氨酶只是轻度升高时，首先考虑TTP，并由急查血涂片见到破碎红细胞证实微血管病性溶血（ISTH 2020诊断指南：先评估临床可能性，再做ADAMTS13检测）。原报告在病程后期才考虑TTP。
teachingPoints.en: Telling pregnancy TMAs apart: severe features of pre-eclampsia (ACOG 2020: platelets < 100×10⁹/L, creatinine > 97 μmol/L, new headache or visual disturbance), HELLP (ACOG 2020: LDH ≥ 600 IU/L, AST/ALT more than twice the upper limit, platelets < 100×10⁹/L) and TTP overlap. Platelets below 30×10⁹/L (one item of the PLASMIC score) with marked anaemia and neurological symptoms, normal clotting and transaminases only mildly raised point to TTP first, with schistocytes on an urgent film to confirm the microangiopathic haemolysis (ISTH 2020 diagnosis guideline: assess the clinical probability, then test ADAMTS13). The report considered TTP only late.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 现行治疗（ISTH 2020，2025年重点更新对免疫性TTP未作改动；BSH 2023；中国TTP指南2022）：一旦高度怀疑，留取ADAMTS13标本后立即开始以血浆为置换液的血浆置换（首次1.5倍血浆容量，每日一次）和甲泼尼龙1 g/d×3天，并有条件推荐加用利妥昔单抗；ISTH还有条件推荐卡普赛珠单抗（caplacizumab），用于已确诊、或ADAMTS13结果未出但可能性很高的免疫性TTP急性发作，与置换和免疫抑制治疗合用——由血液科权衡出血风险和可及性后决定，说明书建议妊娠期避免使用、哺乳期需另作决定，围产期经验仅来自个案报道；ADAMTS13活性<10%支持TTP，>20%基本排除。血浆输注不能代替置换。原报告输注了新鲜冰冻血浆；本病例没有记录血浆置换。
teachingPoints.en: Current treatment (ISTH 2020, unchanged for immune TTP in the 2025 focused update; BSH 2023; Chinese TTP guideline 2022): once TTP is strongly suspected, take the ADAMTS13 sample and start plasma exchange with plasma at once (1.5 plasma volumes at first, daily) with methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 3 days, adding rituximab (a conditional recommendation); ISTH also conditionally recommends caplacizumab for an acute immune-TTP episode, confirmed or highly probable while ADAMTS13 is pending, given with exchange and immunosuppression — a haematology decision weighing bleeding risk and availability, with labelling that advises avoiding it in pregnancy and needs a decision about breastfeeding, and experience around childbirth limited to case reports; activity below 10% supports TTP and above 20% essentially excludes it. Plasma infusion does not replace exchange. The report's team gave fresh frozen plasma; this case records no plasma exchange.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血小板与麻醉：BSH 2023建议TTP中避免输注血小板，除非出现危及生命的出血，观察性数据提示输注与动脉血栓和死亡增加相关。SOAP 2021共识中椎管内阻滞的低风险阈值（≥70×10⁹/L）只适用于妊娠期血小板减少、ITP和妊娠期高血压疾病，不适用于TTP；个位数的计数下剖宫产应选全身麻醉；不能等待的手术是否需要输注血小板，由血液科和麻醉科共同决定。原报告反复输注血小板；本病例没有记录麻醉方式。
teachingPoints.en: Platelets and anaesthesia: BSH 2023 advises avoiding platelet transfusion in TTP unless bleeding is life-threatening, and observational data link it with arterial thrombosis and death. The SOAP 2021 low-risk threshold for a neuraxial block (≥ 70×10⁹/L) applies to gestational thrombocytopenia, ITP and hypertensive disorders, not TTP; at a single-figure count a caesarean needs general anaesthesia, and platelet cover for an operation that cannot wait is decided jointly by haematology and anaesthesia. The report's team transfused platelets repeatedly; this case does not record the anaesthetic.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分娩时机：孕34周以后有子痫前期重度表现时，应在母体稳定后终止妊娠（ACOG 2020），并用硫酸镁预防抽搐（负荷4–6 g，维持1–2 g/h，肾功能受损时减量并监测血镁）；但分娩不能治愈TTP，母体稳定靠的是血浆置换。分娩后LDH继续上升、血小板不回升，就要升级治疗，而不是等待。
teachingPoints.en: Timing of birth: after 34 weeks with severe features of pre-eclampsia, deliver once the mother is stable (ACOG 2020), with magnesium sulfate seizure prophylaxis (4–6 g loading, 1–2 g/h, less and with serum levels when renal function is impaired); but delivery does not cure TTP — stabilising her means plasma exchange. When LDH keeps rising and the platelets do not recover after the birth, escalate rather than wait.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 确诊与随访：报告诊断为TTP，但本病例没有记录ADAMTS13活性和抑制物（抗体）结果，无法区分免疫性TTP与先天性TTP（ADAMTS13基因变异，妊娠可使其首次发病），也不能排除补体介导的TMA。ISTH 2020建议：先天性TTP在妊娠期预防性输注血浆；免疫性TTP缓解后无症状但ADAMTS13活性低时，妊娠期可预防性血浆置换；2025年重点更新对缓解期先天性TTP优先推荐重组ADAMTS13。
teachingPoints.en: Confirmation and follow-up: the report calls this TTP, but with no ADAMTS13 activity or inhibitor (antibody) result recorded, this case cannot separate immune from congenital TTP (ADAMTS13 gene variants, which pregnancy can unmask) or exclude complement-mediated TMA. ISTH 2020 recommends prophylactic plasma infusion in pregnancy for congenital TTP and, for immune TTP in remission with low ADAMTS13 activity, prophylactic plasma exchange during pregnancy; the 2025 focused update prefers recombinant ADAMTS13 for congenital TTP in remission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 当家属考虑撤除治疗：ACCM/ATS 2016政策声明要求医生与代理决策者共同确定治疗目标，包括限制或撤除生命支持；用SPIKES组织谈话，如实说明治疗还能带来什么、预后有多不确定，并探讨她本人的意愿。原报告记录家属最终带她离院；本病例没有记录谈话内容。
teachingPoints.en: When a family considers withdrawing treatment: the ACCM/ATS 2016 policy statement asks clinicians and surrogates to set goals of care together, including limiting or withdrawing life support; SPIKES structures the conversation — what treatment can still offer, how uncertain the outlook is, and what she would have wanted. The report records that the family took her away; this case does not record the conversation.

unknowns.zh-CN: ADAMTS13活性、抑制物（抗ADAMTS13抗体）和基因检测——TTP的类型无从确定。
unknowns.en: ADAMTS13 activity, inhibitor (anti-ADAMTS13 antibody) and genetic testing — the type of TTP cannot be settled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整的溶血指标（胆红素、网织红细胞、结合珠蛋白、直接抗人球蛋白试验），以及入院时的LDH、白细胞和红细胞指数。
unknowns.en: A full haemolysis panel (bilirubin, reticulocytes, haptoglobin, direct antiglobulin test) and the admission LDH, white cell count and red cell indices.

unknowns.zh-CN: 剖宫产的时间、指征、麻醉方式和出血量；新生儿的情况。
unknowns.en: The timing, indication, anaesthetic and blood loss of the caesarean; the baby's condition.

unknowns.zh-CN: 头颅CT、MRI和血涂片的具体时间，以及MRI病灶的部位。
unknowns.en: When the head CT, the MRI and the blood film were done, and where the MRI lesions were.

unknowns.zh-CN: 输注血小板和新鲜冰冻血浆的次数和剂量，以及是否用过硫酸镁、降压药或糖皮质激素。
unknowns.en: How many platelet and plasma transfusions she had and in what doses, and whether magnesium sulfate, antihypertensives or corticosteroids were given.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征（入院时的心率、呼吸、血氧饱和度和之后的全部数值）、心力衰竭的检查依据（任何阶段都没有肌钙蛋白、心电图或超声心动图结果）、呼吸机参数和升压药剂量。
unknowns.en: Vital signs (the admission heart rate, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation, and every later value), the findings behind the heart-failure diagnosis (no troponin, ECG or echocardiogram result at any stage), ventilator settings and vasopressor doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、用药、过敏史、家族史，家属放弃治疗的原因，以及她离院后的结局。
unknowns.en: Past history, medicines, allergies, family history, the family's reasons for stopping treatment, and what happened after she left.
